description: This file defines functions and classes for creating and managing different types of browsers within the Playwright testing framework, including remote, CDP, isolated, and persistent browsers. It handles browser initialization, user data directory management, port finding, and profile locking checks.

classes.name: BrowserContextFactory
classes.description: Interface defining methods for managing browser contexts, including retrieving existing contexts and creating new ones.

methods.name: createBrowser
methods.description: Main function to create a browser instance based on configuration, supporting remote, CDP, isolated, extension, and persistent browsers.

methods.name: createIsolatedBrowser
methods.description: Creates an isolated browser instance with specific launch options.

methods.name: createCDPBrowser
methods.description: Creates a browser connected over Chrome DevTools Protocol.

methods.name: createRemoteBrowser
methods.description: Connects to a remote browser endpoint, possibly across different versions.

methods.name: createPersistentBrowser
methods.description: Creates or connects to a persistent browser profile, managing user data directories and handling profile locks.

methods.name: createUserDataDir
methods.description: Generates a user data directory path based on client info and configuration.

methods.name: injectCdpPort
methods.description: Injects a free port into the browser configuration for Chromium browsers.

methods.name: createHash
methods.description: Creates a SHA-256 hash of input data, truncated to 7 characters.

methods.name: computeTracesDir
methods.description: Computes the directory path for storing traces.

methods.name: isProfileLocked5Times
methods.description: Checks if a user data profile is locked, retrying up to 5 times.

methods.name: isProfileLocked
methods.description: Determines if a user profile directory is currently locked.

methods.name: throwBrowserIsNotInstalledError
methods.description: Throws an error if the required browser is not installed, with instructions.
